picks.excerpt: ReFace 2.0 for Blender now cleans up messy geometry from 3D scans, AI-generated models and sculpts, making hard-surface retopology far less manual.
picks.rationale: A concrete Blender tool release that turns AI/scan output into production-ready hard-surface topology — changes an asset artist's pipeline tomorrow.

picks.excerpt: Blizzard devs break down the procedural generation system behind Diablo V's open world, a technology they say has been in development since Diablo III.
picks.rationale: First-party technical breakdown of a decade-long procedural world system — rare craft detail from a AAA studio, directly useful to level and systems designers.

picks.excerpt: A developer vibe-coded a VR tool that lets him physically toss a 3D model at his printer inside mixed reality to start a print job.
picks.rationale: A working example of vibe-coding a spatial interaction tool — shows how cheap bespoke XR utilities have become for a solo maker.

picks.excerpt: A modding project called UNCANNY uses NVIDIA DLSS 5 neural rendering to deliver real-time remasters, making both classic and modern games look like new titles.
picks.rationale: Neural rendering moves from vendor demo to a community remastering engine — a new production route for art direction on legacy titles.

picks.excerpt: A PS5 Linux developer is walking away from the project, saying open-source mod work has been overrun by 'AI slop kiddies' using LLMs to write hacks they don't understand.
picks.rationale: The maintenance cost of LLM-written contributions is now driving senior maintainers out — a warning for any team accepting AI-assisted code.
